# Load tidyverse
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
# Load Expression data
```{r}
expr <- read.delim("brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_mrna_seq_v2_rsem.txt", check.names = FALSE)
expr[,1] <- make.unique(expr[,1])
rownames(expr) <- expr[,1]
expr <- expr[,-1]
expr <- as.data.frame(t(expr))
expr$Sample_ID <- rownames(expr)
```
# Load both clinical files
```{r}
clin_patient <- read.delim("brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_clinical_patient.txt", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
clin_sample  <- read.delim("brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_clinical_sample.txt",  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
# Rename the shared identifier column to a clean name
```{r}
colnames(clin_patient)[1] <- "PATIENT_ID"
colnames(clin_sample)[1]  <- "PATIENT_ID"
```
# Merge the clinical data on PATIENT_ID
```{r}
clin <- merge(clin_patient, clin_sample, by = "PATIENT_ID", all = TRUE)
```
# check olumn names after merging
```{r}
colnames(clin)
```
#Create TNBC Label Using Subtype
```{r}
library(dplyr)

clin <- clin %>%
  mutate(TNBC = ifelse(Subtype == "BRCA_Basal", 1, 0)) %>%
  drop_na(Subtype)
```
#Merge Clinical with Expression Data
```{r}
final_data <- inner_join(expr, clin, by = c("Sample_ID" = "Sample Identifier"))
```
# Clean data
```{r}
expr_only <- final_data %>%
  select(-Sample_ID, -Subtype, -PATIENT_ID, -`TCGA PanCanAtlas Cancer Type Acronym`, -TNBC)

labels <- final_data$TNBC
```
# Filter top variable genes
```{r}
top_var_genes <- apply(expr_only, 2, var)
expr_filtered <- expr_only[, order(top_var_genes, decreasing = TRUE)[1:1000]]
```
# Sanity check
```{r}
dim(expr_filtered)
summary(expr_filtered[,1:5])
```
# Extract Sample_IDs
```{r}
sample_ids <- rownames(expr_filtered)
```
# Create a lookup from final_data
```{r}
label_df <- final_data[, c("Sample_ID", "TNBC")]
```
# Match labels using sample ID
```{r}
labels <- label_df$TNBC[match(sample_ids, label_df$Sample_ID)]
```
# Convert to factor
```{r}
labels <- as.factor(labels)
```
# Check result
```{r}
table(labels)
```
# Check sample IDs
```{r}
head(rownames(expr_filtered))
head(final_data$Sample_ID)
```
# Update rownames of expr_filtered
```{r}
rownames(expr_filtered) <- final_data$Sample_ID
```
# Let's rerun
```{r}
labels <- final_data$TNBC[match(rownames(expr_filtered), final_data$Sample_ID)]
labels <- as.factor(labels)
table(labels)
```
## let's build a clssifier
# Train-Test Split
```{r}
library(caret)
set.seed(42)

split <- createDataPartition(labels, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_x <- expr_filtered[split, ]
train_y <- labels[split]
test_x  <- expr_filtered[-split, ]
test_y  <- labels[-split]
```
# Train a Random Forest
```{r}
library(randomForest)

rf_model <- randomForest(x = train_x, y = train_y, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# Predict on test set
pred_rf <- predict(rf_model, test_x)

# Confusion matrix
confusionMatrix(pred_rf, test_y)
```
#Plot ROC Curve
```{r}
library(pROC)
prob_rf <- predict(rf_model, test_x, type = "prob")[, 2]
roc_rf <- roc(test_y, prob_rf)
plot(roc_rf, col = "blue", print.auc = TRUE, main = "ROC Curve - TNBC Classifier")
```
#Extract Top Predictive Genes (Biomarkers)
```{r}
imp <- importance(rf_model)
top_genes <- rownames(imp)[order(imp[, "MeanDecreaseGini"], decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]]
top_genes
```
#Visualize Top Gene Expression
```{r}
gene <- top_genes[1]
boxplot(expr_filtered[, gene] ~ labels, main = paste("Expression of", gene), xlab = "TNBC Status", ylab = "Expression")
```
# Repeat boxplot for top 10 -20 genes
```{r}
for (gene in top_genes[1:5]) {
  boxplot(expr_filtered[, gene] ~ labels,
          main = paste("Expression of", gene),
          ylab = "Expression", xlab = "TNBC Status",
          col = "gray")
}
```
#Violin Plot for a Top Gene (e.g., SPDEF)
# Load required libraries
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```
# Define your gene of interest
```{r}
gene <- "SPDEF"
```
# Create a plotting dataframe
```{r}
plot_df <- data.frame(
  Expression = expr_filtered[, gene],
  TNBC_Status = labels
)
```
# Create violin plot with boxplot and significance star
```{r}
ggviolin(plot_df, x = "TNBC_Status", y = "Expression", fill = "TNBC_Status",
         palette = c("#00BFC4", "#F8766D"),  # blue for 0, red for 1
         add = "boxplot", add.params = list(fill = "white")) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
  labs(title = paste("Expression of", gene),
       x = "TNBC Status", y = "Expression") +
  theme_minimal()
```
# for top 5-10 markers
```{r}
for (gene in top_genes[1:5]) {
  plot_df <- data.frame(Expression = expr_filtered[, gene], TNBC_Status = labels)
  print(
    ggviolin(plot_df, x = "TNBC_Status", y = "Expression", fill = "TNBC_Status",
             palette = c("#00BFC4", "#F8766D"), add = "boxplot",
             add.params = list(fill = "white")) +
      stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
      labs(title = paste("Expression of", gene),
           x = "TNBC Status", y = "Expression") +
      theme_minimal()
  )
}
```
## heat map of top 20 genes
```{r}
install.packages("pheatmap")  # if not already installed
library(pheatmap)
```
# Select top 20 genes by importance
```{r}
top20_genes <- rownames(importance(rf_model))[order(importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"], decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]]
```
# Subset expression matrix to top 20 genes
```{r}
heatmap_data <- t(expr_filtered[, top20_genes])  # genes in rows, samples in columns
```
# Create annotation for TNBC status
```{r}
annotation_col <- data.frame(TNBC_Status = labels)
rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(expr_filtered)
```
# Plot the heatmap
```{r}
pheatmap(heatmap_data,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         scale = "row",  # standardize each gene (row-wise)
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
         main = "Top 20 Predictive Genes Across TNBC and non-TNBC Samples",
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         cluster_rows = TRUE)
```
#Install and load required packages
```{r}
install.packages("ggpubr")
install.packages("patchwork")

library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
```
# Select the top 4 genes
```{r}
selected_genes <- top_genes[1:4]
```
# Create violin plots for each gene
```{r}
plots <- lapply(selected_genes, function(gene) {
  df <- data.frame(Expression = expr_filtered[, gene], TNBC_Status = labels)
  
  ggviolin(df, x = "TNBC_Status", y = "Expression", fill = "TNBC_Status",
           palette = c("#00BFC4", "#F8766D"), add = "boxplot",
           add.params = list(fill = "white")) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
    labs(title = gene, x = NULL, y = "Expression") +
    theme_minimal()
})
```
# Combine plots into a 2x2 layout
```{r}
(plots[[1]] | plots[[2]]) /
(plots[[3]] | plots[[4]])
```
##Train an XGBoost Classifier
# Load required packages
```{r}
install.packages("xgboost")
library(xgboost)
```
# Prepare data for XGBOOST
# Convert data to matrix and labels to numeric
```{r}
xgb_train <- as.matrix(train_x)
xgb_test  <- as.matrix(test_x)
xgb_label_train <- as.numeric(as.character(train_y))
xgb_label_test  <- as.numeric(as.character(test_y))
```
Train the XGBoost Model
```{r}
xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = xgb_train,
  label = xgb_label_train,
  nrounds = 100,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  verbose = 0
)
```
# Predict probabilities
```{r}
xgb_prob <- predict(xgb_model, xgb_test)
```
# Convert probabilities to class labels
```{r}
xgb_pred <- ifelse(xgb_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
```
# Confusion matrix
```{r}
library(caret)
confusionMatrix(as.factor(xgb_pred), as.factor(xgb_label_test))
```
# ROC Curve
```{r}
library(pROC)
xgb_roc <- roc(xgb_label_test, xgb_prob)
plot(xgb_roc, col = "darkgreen", print.auc = TRUE, main = "ROC Curve - XGBoost Classifier")
```
# Get feature importance
```{r}
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_model)
```
# Select top 20 genes
```{r}
top20_xgb_genes <- importance_matrix$Feature[1:20]
top20_xgb_genes
```
# Generate violin + boxplots for top 4 genes
```{r}
selected_genes <- top20_xgb_genes[1:4]

violin_plots <- lapply(selected_genes, function(gene) {
  df <- data.frame(Expression = expr_filtered[, gene], TNBC_Status = labels)
  
  ggviolin(df, x = "TNBC_Status", y = "Expression", fill = "TNBC_Status",
           palette = c("#00BFC4", "#F8766D"), add = "boxplot",
           add.params = list(fill = "white")) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
    labs(title = gene, x = "TNBC Status", y = "Expression") +
    theme_minimal()
})
```
# Combine into a 2x2 layout
```{r}
multi_violin_plot <- (violin_plots[[1]] | violin_plots[[2]]) /
                     (violin_plots[[3]] | violin_plots[[4]])
```

# Display
```{r}
multi_violin_plot
```
# Prepare heatmap data
```{r}
heatmap_data_xgb <- t(expr_filtered[, top20_xgb_genes])
```
# Annotation
```{r}
annotation_col <- data.frame(TNBC_Status = labels)
rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(expr_filtered)
```
# Draw heatmap
```{r}
pheatmap(heatmap_data_xgb,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         scale = "row",
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
         main = "Top 20 Predictive Genes from XGBoost")
```
# optional figure
```{r}
ggsave("xgb_top4_violin.png", plot = multi_violin_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
# Load required libraries
```{r}
library(e1071)
library(caret)
```
# Train SVM with radial kernel
```{r}
svm_model <- svm(train_x, train_y, kernel = "radial", probability = TRUE)
```
# Predict on test set
```{r}
svm_pred <- predict(svm_model, test_x)
```
# Confusion matrix
```{r}
confusionMatrix(svm_pred, test_y)
```
# Predict probabilities
```{r}
svm_prob <- attr(predict(svm_model, test_x, probability = TRUE), "probabilities")[,2]
```
# ROC and AUC
```{r}
library(pROC)
svm_roc <- roc(as.numeric(as.character(test_y)), svm_prob)
```
# Plot ROC curve
```{r}
plot(svm_roc, col = "purple", main = "ROC Curve - SVM", print.auc = TRUE)
```
# Ensure TRain_X is numeric or dataframe
```{r}
str(train_x)
```
# Reload the libraries
```{r}
library(caret)
library(kernlab)
```
# check class distribution
```{r}
table(train_y)
```
# Updated working code sine train-y is imbalanced
```{r}
library(caret)
library(kernlab)

set.seed(123)

# Ensure class labels are factors
train_y <- as.factor(train_y)
```
# Train the SVM model directly
```{r}
svm_model <- train(
  x = train_x,
  y = train_y,
  method = "svmRadial",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)
)
```
# Check class and structure
```{r}
importance <- varImp(svm_model)
print(class(importance))       # Should include "varImp.train"
print(names(importance))       # Should include "importance"
str(importance)
```
# Extract the importance table
```{r}
imp_df <- importance$importance
```
# Compute average importance score across both classes
```{r}
imp_df$Overall <- rowMeans(imp_df)
```
# Extract top 20 genes by overall importance
```{r}
top_genes <- rownames(imp_df)[order(imp_df$Overall, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]]
print(top_genes)
```
# Prepare data for plotting
```{r}
# Subset and prepare your training data
genes_of_interest <- c("MLPH", "FOXA1", "XBP1", "KPNA2")
subset_data <- train_x[, genes_of_interest]
subset_data$TNBC <- factor(train_y, labels = c("Non-TNBC", "TNBC"))
```
# Create individual ggplot objects
```{r}
gene_plots <- lapply(genes_of_interest, function(gene) {
  ggplot(subset_data, aes_string(x = "TNBC", y = gene, fill = "TNBC")) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = gene, x = "", y = "Expression") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
})
```
# Combine into one panel (2x2 layout)
```{r}
combined_panel <- (gene_plots[[1]] | gene_plots[[2]]) / (gene_plots[[3]] | gene_plots[[4]])
```
# Display
```{r}
combined_panel
```
# Subset expression data for these genes
```{r}
heatmap_data <- train_x[, top_genes]
```
# Optional: Z-score normalization per gene (standard practice in heatmaps)
```{r}
heatmap_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))
```
# Create annotation for TNBC vs non-TNBC
```{r}
annotation <- data.frame(TNBC = factor(train_y, labels = c("Non-TNBC", "TNBC")))
rownames(annotation) <- rownames(heatmap_scaled)
```
# Plot the heatmap
```{r}
pheatmap(
  mat = heatmap_scaled,
  annotation_row = annotation,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize = 10,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  scale = "none",
  main = "Heatmap of Top 20 SVM Genes"
)
```
